mapping.summary: Rich-text pop-up notes, @-tagging and event-driven email notifications inside BC.
claims: Rich-text HTML notes with links and images on customers, vendors, items and sales and purchase documents
Tag users or groups with @ to notify them
Notes emailed to users or groups, including external ones, with a link back to the record
Tagging available on sales and purchase documents, master data and production orders
Pop-up notes appear when the customer, vendor or item is used on documents
Pop-up notes can auto-save and copy onto the transaction
Event alerts for PO approved or received, SO approved or shipped, unshipped or uninvoiced orders
Alerts on expiring quotes, received prepayments, negative inventory and inventory adjustments
Warns at a user-defined credit threshold and can block when the limit is exceeded
Choose BC notification, email or both
Imports notes from a previous system via XML
My Notifications view on the role center
Notes can be moved to Azure Blob Storage
